Thunder have the MVP, but LAC much deeper.

items.title: Asked Derrick Jones Jr. about the Thunder
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Asked Derrick Jones Jr. about the Thunder

"You can't go out there just because they're down a few players, you can't just go out there and think it's going to be an easy game. Those are the games that you get blown out the water... those guys that are stepping up, they're taking on a bigger role"

items.title: Asked Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. about how players use days off and practice at this time of the year
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Asked Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. about how players use days off and practice at this time of the year

Dunn: "fix what you need to fix, come out with more urgency"

Jones: "You've got to go out there and put the effort out there...It should be our identity to play one way"
